visual_elements.description: Feed-forward/backpropagation schematic inside a light rounded-rectangle container. Far left: three small filled purple dots in a vertical column. Black arrows point right into three hidden-layer summation nodes drawn as pale-green circles containing Σ. Each hidden Σ is followed by a small yellow activation square with a diagonal glyph, then a small white circle labeled lowercase 'o'. Blue upward arrows enter the hidden Σ nodes as biases. Arrows from the hidden 'o' circles point right into three output-layer Σ nodes. Above each output Σ is a small yellow square labeled 'Net' with a downward arrow into the Σ. To the right of each output Σ is a small circle labeled uppercase 'O', then a black arrow to 'Output1', 'Output2', and 'Outputm'. Blue upward bias arrows also enter the output Σ nodes. Black arrows from the outputs point right into a vertical red bar labeled 'Error' (the word appears repeated down the bar in the capture). Dotted curved arrows run from the output/error side back over the top of the output layer toward the hidden layer; two small yellow circular nodes sit in this dotted path and are unlabeled/illegible [?]. A bottom-left legend marker reads 'Node Bias'.

White panel with dark-red border, divided into three horizontal rows. Left column text: 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m'. Right column: the same stacked fraction ∂E over ∂w_ji with a red question mark on each row.
Yellow circular badge with black outline and black numeral '8'.

recreation_brief:
1) Set the slide background to white. Draw a dark-red (#8B0000) rectangular border around the whole content area; treat the black strip below the frame as a video artifact, not slide content.
2) Do not add a title. In the top band, place the network diagram container (light #F7F7F7 fill, #8B0000 outline) roughly from 24% to 70% width and 10% to 60% height.
3) Inside the diagram, draw three small purple (#800080) input dots on the far left. Arrow them right into three hidden-layer Σ circles with pale-green fill (#C8E6C9) and dark-green outline (#006400). After each hidden Σ, draw a small yellow (#FFFF99) activation square with a diagonal glyph, then a small white circle labeled 'o'. Add blue (#1E90FF) upward bias arrows into each hidden Σ and place the legend text 'Node Bias' at the bottom-left.
4) Draw three output-layer Σ circles in the same green style. Above each output Σ, place a small yellow square labeled 'Net' with a downward arrow into the Σ. To the right of each output Σ, place a small circle labeled 'O', then arrow to the labels 'Output1', 'Output2', and 'Outputm'. Add blue upward bias arrows into the output Σ nodes.
5) On the far right of the diagram, draw a vertical red (#FF0000) bar labeled 'Error'; in the capture the word repeats down the bar. Draw black arrows from the outputs into this bar. Add dotted curved arrows from the output/error side back over the top toward the hidden layer, with two small unlabeled yellow circles in that dotted path.
6) Top-right: draw a yellow (#FFFF00) circle with a black outline containing '8'.
7) Below that badge, draw a white panel with a #8B0000 border and three rows. Left column: 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m'. Right column on every row: a stacked fraction with numerator '∂ E' and denominator '∂ w_ji' with 'ji' as a subscript, followed by a red question mark.
8) Leave the lower part of the framed slide empty.
